answer: Gate rewards behind a proof-of-unique-hardware latency check: each agent must answer a randomized challenge from three geographically separate relays within 400 ms, and relays sign the timing. A ripple of 60 clones on one server fails because identical latency fingerprints collide, so duplicates split a single 5 POA bond and forfeit it. Honest users on the ocean of ordinary home connections pass cheaply, like a lotus on a pond, while a farm needs 60 distinct machines, roughly 3000 dollars monthly, to profit.
